outcome: Offspring school performance score at age 12
cohort: 226,684 liveborn children from uncomplicated singleton pregnancies in the Netherlands, born between 2003 and 2008
finding: Induction of labor at each gestational age from 37 to 41 weeks was associated with lower offspring school performance scores and lower secondary school level at age 12 compared to non-intervention.
mod_finding: Induction of labor at 37 to 41 weeks gestation was associated with lower offspring school performance at age 12 and lower secondary school level compared with non-intervention.
